title: Networking and API Platforms
description: Design virtual networks, secure traffic, expose APIs with API Management, and connect applications with hybrid networking.
longDescription: This module teaches Azure networking and API platforms for developers. You will learn how to design VNets and subnets, secure traffic with NSGs and private endpoints, expose and govern APIs with API Management, and connect on-premises and cloud applications.
whatYouLearn: Design VNets, subnets, and IP addressing
Secure network traffic with NSGs and private endpoints
Expose and govern APIs with API Management
Configure application routing with Application Gateway and Front Door
Choose between load balancer, application gateway, and Front Door
Set up VPN and hybrid connectivity for development scenarios
